selection_authority.predicate: manifest order where expected.accepted=true and expected.lowering_eligible=true

generated_external_oracle.predicate: Lowering.generated=true and entry_point is registered in tools/kernel_oracles.py

checked_cuda_asset.protocol: report separately as missing until a current successor launch or exact current-lowering-to-observed-binary identity chain exists; never relabel historical r31 evidence

acceptance.generated_partition: all 14 selected cases write a durable record after compile and launch, and pass their external oracle under the unchanged tolerance
acceptance.checked_asset_partition: reported separately as passed, failed or missing; absence cannot count as a pass
acceptance.failure_semantics: retain every record and any pre-record failure; no failure authorizes a retry, tolerance change or evidence rewrite
acceptance.non_claim: does not establish performance, end-to-end framework correctness, ranking quality, KDA-version expressibility or paper reproduction
